description: Import a batch of forum threads and posts from another platform into a community (#86). Owner or PDS admin only. Records are written by the community, in its own repository and signed with its key, with record keys derived from the source ids: a batch sent again creates nothing new.

platform.description: The platform the content comes from. Only `discord` is supported.

posts.description: Posts, oldest first. A post's thread, and the post it replies to, must be in this batch (earlier) or already imported.

errors.name: ThreadNotFound
errors.description: A post names a thread that is neither in the batch nor already imported.

errors.name: ParentNotFound
errors.description: A post replies to a post that is neither earlier in the batch nor already imported in the same thread.

errors.name: NotMember
errors.description: Caller is not a member of this community.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Caller is not the community's owner or a PDS admin.

errors.name: CommunityMoved
errors.description: The community has moved to another PDS; this copy is read-only (#267).

errors.name: CommunityImporting
errors.description: The community is still arriving here and is not active yet (#267).

errors.name: CommunitySuspended
errors.description: The community has been suspended by the PDS administrator and accepts no writes.

errors.name: CommunityTakenDown
errors.description: The community has been taken down.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Community not found, or private and not visible to the caller.

importThread.description: A channel or thread on the source platform, imported as a forum thread.

channelId.description: Source id of the channel or thread (a Discord snowflake). Determines the record key.

createdAt.description: When the channel's first imported message was written.

importPost.description: A message on the source platform, imported as a forum post.

channelId.description: Source id of the channel or thread the message was in; names the forum thread.

messageId.description: Source id of the message. Determines the record key.

replyToMessageId.description: Source id of the message this one answered, in the same channel.

createdAt.description: When the message was originally written.

author.description: How the original author is shown (by default a per-import label such as "Discord member 3").

existing.description: Records that were already there (an earlier run) and were left as they are.
